verdict.rationale: Decorating functions with `weave.op` produces a nested trace tree, and Threads group traces into a single session or conversation. Sessions, turns, steps, tools and sub-agents are first-class concepts. Custom agent loops can be wrapped with `start_conversation`, `start_turn`, `start_llm` and `start_tool`, and popular agent SDKs are traced with just `weave.init()`. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the nested-span and session grouping behavior.
